profile_surface_label: Example State official voter-information social-profile surface
delivery_role_note: Persistent social-profile surfaces help the public recognize official election accounts and route into current official help, but they do not become the rule source by themselves.
display_name_policy_note: Display names and handles should make the authoritative office and jurisdiction recognizable, including when a platform shows the profile without surrounding post context.
bio_identity_policy_note: The biography/about field should identify the office, jurisdiction, and general role of the account clearly enough that a voter can tell which official source they are viewing.
bio_link_policy_note: The profile-level link should route to a current official-domain destination or authoritative office/help lane, not an expired election microsite or opaque third-party destination.
pinned_item_policy_note: Pinned items are either evergreen routing posts or explicitly dated/scoped operational items that are reviewed, replaced, stale-marked, or unpinned when they stop controlling.
featured_media_policy_note: Highlights, story collections, and featured media that carry voter-information routing or instructions keep date/scope visible and point back to the current official destination or help lane.
identity_transition_policy_note: Handle or account migrations produce explicit successor-account recovery on the legacy profile and in the official channel directory.
